variants.name: sample-replies
variants.why: Two threads start with sample replies, so the feed count starts above zero and must rise by one.

variants.name: author-name-only
variants.why: The author button is named by the author's name alone, as the brief words it, without profile or author.

variants.name: authors-in-feed
variants.why: Every feed row also names its author with a button, so the author button of the open thread is not new there; the thread credits it with Started by.

variants.name: byline-replies
variants.why: Each reply shares its list item with a byline (You: text); its characters are still rendered literally.

variants.name: alternate-wording
variants.why: Other usual wording: the field is Your reply (required), the buttons are Post, Follow thread and Unfollow thread, a link named with an arrow, Back to feed, returns to the feed, and the feed says No replies yet, then Replies: 1.

variants.name: following-checkbox
variants.why: The Following filter is a labelled checkbox instead of a pair of buttons.
